Technician app questions

Before the crew goes live.

Does the technician app work offline?

PestFlow states that assigned jobs and field records can cache on the device and sync when connectivity returns.

Can technicians see all company data?

The field workflow is designed around assigned jobs and role-based access rather than unrestricted office access.

What evidence can crews capture?

Treatment details, notes, GPS-related check-in records, QR or barcode asset scans, photos and customer signatures.

Does completion create a report?

Completed field records feed the digital service-report workflow.
